title: IS forming bearing pattern
technician_note: When vibration rises with temperature check lubrication first
summary: High vibration with high temperature often indicates bearing wear or lubrication issue

title: Packaging vacuum pickup issue
symptoms: missed bottle pickup and low vacuum
recommended_action: Replace suction cups and inspect vacuum hose
technician_note: Suction cup wear repeats after long production campaigns
summary: Low vacuum and pickup faults often point to worn suction cups or hose leakage

title: Conveyor misalignment
technician_note: Current spikes with belt drift means check tracking before replacing motor
summary: Conveyor current spikes with low speed can indicate misalignment or blockage

title: Furnace overheating
recommended_action: Clean burner and inspect flow path
technician_note: Do not wait for shutdown if temperature trend rises quickly
summary: Temperature drift with flow loss may indicate burner or flow restriction

title: Feeder pressure instability
cause: filter blockage valve leakage or regulator issue
technician_note: Pressure loss often comes from filter and small leaks
summary: Low pressure with low flow suggests blockage leakage or pump degradation
